_doc: Stream B. Which world zones each of stream E's province sheets uses (data/provinces/<id>.json `zones.<id>.grid`). block = the world zone (zx, zy) of E's grid [0,0]; map = E zone id -> world zone id. tools/bake-zone.mjs reads it for per-zone sites (an event arena per zone; the world boss arena in the sheet's worldBossZone). Re-run E's tools/assign-vignettes.mjs + place-vignettes.mjs after any change here.
